title: Leaderboard Ranking Has Two Separate Bugs
description:
This one has **two independent bugs**. `rank_players(players)` should sort players by score, highest first. `top_n_average(players, n)` should average the scores of the top `n` players (after ranking). Both are currently wrong in different ways. Find both bugs and fix them so every hidden test passes.

**Function signatures**
`rank_players(players: list[dict]) -> list[dict]`
`top_n_average(players: list[dict], n: int) -> float`

**Example**
Players with scores `[10, 30, 20]`: `rank_players` -> scores in order `[30, 20, 10]`. `top_n_average(players, 2)` -> average of the top 2 scores, `25.0`.
